# Vendor dependency updates require consistent owned Cargo source identity

1275 changes the same ews-rs Git revision in the source-replacement config, Cargo lock and ews_xpcom dependency. The six vendor API/checksum paths are imported code, not Thunderbird manual-style examples. Accepted source now depends on a registry ews version, and its lock records ews 0.1.1; the earlier Git pin has been replaced. A scoped build recommendation is to compare all owned dependency identities for the current source mode instead of copying the historical Git config. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: rust/.cargo/config.toml.in.
